title: Common Child
description: A string is said to be a child of a another string if it can be formed by deleting 0 or more characters from the other string. Letters cannot be rearranged. Given two strings of equal length, what's the longest string that can be constructed such that it is a child of both?
input_format: There are two lines, each with a string, s1 and s2.
output_format: Print the length of the longest string which is a common child of both input strings.
constraints: All characters are upper case in the range ascii[A-Z].
